name: Hadron Collider / sparse four-live representative

**Crank**

This enters the arena with 4 steam counters. At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter from it.

When you **boost** an attack, destroy this. If you do, the attack gets +X{p}, where X is the number of steam counters on this. Representative only: actual_four_steam_entry_then_positive_crank_removes_one_and_gains_action_point. Other pitch siblings, alternate targets and unexercised branches receive no credit.
